# vscode-server

slagent's editor is VS Code itself: the open source web server from [microsoft/vscode](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode)
(`reh-web`), built here with a small patch set and shown in an iframe in editor mode.

- `VERSION` the upstream tag we build.
- `patches/` changes to upstream source, applied in order by `build.sh`. Keep them small; each one is a rebase cost on upgrade. Five today: default settings and connection token for the web client, skipping the Copilot post-step, the host page CSS and font channel, the Open VSX resource proxy host fix, and a 200px minimum width for the explorer.
- `product.overrides.json` Open VSX gallery and default settings (hidden chrome, no AI features, no telemetry).
- `extensions/slagent-bridge/` built-in extension the app uses to open files, run view commands and update settings.
- `extensions/slagent-i18n-hints/` built-in extension that shows English react-i18next JSON values as inline hints. Repository `.vscode/settings.json` values are the primary configuration; see its README for the resource path template.
- `extensions/slagent-theme/` the bundled Slagent Light and Dark themes. Their colour files are generated by `finish.mjs` from the app's tokens (`src/renderer/src/index.css` through `src/shared/editor-theme.ts`). They are only the defaults: the workbench auto-detects the colour scheme and the user can pick any other theme.
- `finish.mjs` merges the overrides, removes extensions we do not ship, adds the bridge and i18n hints extensions, and generates the themes.
- `build.sh` produces `dist/<platform>-<arch>` (git-ignored).

```sh
NODE24_BIN=/path/to/node24/bin ./build.sh        # minified
MIN=0 NODE24_BIN=... ./build.sh                  # faster, larger
```

Upgrading: bump `VERSION`, run `build.sh`; fix any patch that no longer applies.
